title: ical4j resolves UTC exceptions across the Paris daylight-saving change
summary: The parent retained January 2 despite a UTC exception at its Paris start. The fix removed just that occurrence, kept an exception at its end harmless and switched to the summer offset on March 31.

change.description: Recurrence expansion compares an exception date with an occurrence start on the time line, so different zone representations can identify one occurrence.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
